{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Render SS= File:SS Wooden Bow Render.png |Model SS= File:SS Wooden Bow Model.png |Model SSHD= File:SSHD Wooden Bow Model.png |Model BotW= File:BotW Wooden Bow Model.png |Model TotK= File:TotK Wooden Bow Model.png |Sprite SS= File:SS Bow Icon.png |Sprite SSHD= File:SSHD Wooden Bow Icon.png |Sprite BotW= File:BotW Wooden Bow Icon.png }} |caption= |pronunciation= |plural= |type= |game= SS, BotW, TotK |other= AoC |cost= |value= |location= {{Spawn Locations}} |uses= Shooting [[Enemy|Enemies]] |strength= 4 {{Exp Game|BotW}} |durability= 20 {{Exp Game|BotW}} |comp= |sample= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Wooden Bow|Wooden Bows|Series, SS, BotW, TotK, AoC|plural}} are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|SS, BotW, TotK, AoC}}{{Name Ref|SSHD}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{SS|-}}=== The Wooden Bow is found inside a [[Treasure Chest]] on the bow of the [[Sandship]] after defeating [[LD-002G Scervo]] in {{SS}}. It can be aimed and drawn for a longer period of time to increase its overall strength. For a price, [[Link]] can [[Upgrade]] the Wooden Bow into an [[Iron Bow]]. ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 4 |durability = 20 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Wooden Bow}} Wooden Bows are weak [[Bow]]s that are used by weaker [[Enemy|Enemies]] in [[Hyrule Field]] and [[West Necluda]]. Though they are not well suited for battle, they are known to be useful for hunting small [[Animal]]s. Being made from wood, Wooden Bows will burn if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. If they are not put away or extinguished, they will eventually disintegrate. They also float if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], which is useful for retrieving them. Finally, they do not conduct [[Electricity]] or attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s, and they cannot be picked up with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. {{BotW Bow Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Bow_038" |Life = 20 |Power = 4 |Range = 20.0 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 4 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 4 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 5 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 7 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 5 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 10 |PoweredSharpAddSpreadFire = false |PoweredSharpAddZoomRapid = false |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMin = 1.1 |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMax = 1.3 |ArrowName = "" |IsLeadShot = false |LeadShotNum = 0 |LeadShotAng = 45.0 |IsRapidFire = false |RapidFireNum = 0 |ArrowGravity = -9.8 |ArrowChargeRate = 1.0 |ArrowReloadRate = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Wooden Bow}} {{Stub|TotK}} Wooden Bows reappear in {{TotK}}. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Teba Weapon }} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Wooden Bow Icon.png|Icon for the Wooden Bow from {{AoC|-}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Bow }} {{Ref| {{Cite Book||quote= |book= E |publisher= |page= 143 {{Exp Game|SS}}}} {{Cite|Upgrade your Wooden Bow to an Iron Bow with increased attack power!|N/A|SS}} {{Cite|{{Big|Wooden Bow}}
